source: 13. What does reranking contribute after retrieval, and why is it still useful even when the first-stage retriever is strong? [Intermediate - System Design] First-stage retrieval is optimized to search a large corpus efficiently, so it often uses cheaper lexical or embedding scores. Reranking spends more computation on a much smaller candidate set using a stronger relevance model or richer query-document interaction. In ZXNAME0000XZ, its value is not merely a higher search metric: it determines which evidence consumes the limited generator context. A better reranker can remove plausible-but-wrong chunks and move truly supporting passages into the prompt. The trade-off is extra latency and cost, and reranking only helps documents that the first stage retrieved. A useful design is therefore to measure first-stage evidence recall at candidate depth, reranker gains at several cutoffs, and end-to-end answer quality. Anthropic’s Contextual Retrieval experiments, for example, reported additional retrieval improvements when reranking was added, but those numbers are specific to its evaluated corpora and models. [5]
zh: 13. 检索后重新排序有什么作用？为什么即使第一阶段检索器很强，它仍然有用？ [中级 - 系统设计] 第一阶段检索经过优化，可以有效地搜索大型语料库，因此它通常使用更便宜的词汇或嵌入分数。重新排序使用更强的相关性模型或更丰富的查询文档交互在更小的候选集上花费更多的计算。在 ZXNAME0000XZ 中，它的价值不仅仅是更高的搜索度量：它确定哪些证据消耗有限的生成器上下文。更好的重新排序器可以删除看似合理但错误的块，并将真正支持的段落移至提示中。代价是额外的延迟和成本，并且重新排名仅对第一阶段检索的文档有帮助。因此，一个有用的设计是测量候选深度的第一阶段证据召回率、多个截止点的重排序增益以及端到端答案质量。例如，Anthropic 的上下文检索实验报告了添加重新排名后检索的额外改进，但这些数字特定于其评估的语料库和模型。 [5]
